title_sq: Vila ne shitje te liqeni i Farkes
description_sq:
Smart Hills eshte nje nder projektet me te reja ne zone i cili pozicionohet ne perendim te liqenit te Farkes.
Kjo zone eshte e njohur per vlerat e saj rezidenciale te cilat shprehen ne aspektin klimaterik dhe ambiental.
Vlen te permendet pamja panoramike qe ofrohet ne drejtim te Jug-Perendimit.
Zona eshte e pasur me burime ujore ne formen e liqeneve , baseneve ujore dhe perrenjve.Bimesia ne kete zone eshte e pasur me lloje te tipit shkurre dhe pemetari mesatare.Vlen te permendim Liqenin e Farkes i cili eshte nje atraksion qe ndodhet rreth 200 m nga vendodhja e prones.
Ne aspektin e sherbimeve tregtare, prona ka nje distance prej 3.7 km, nga Qendra tregtare TEG.
Lidhja kryesore me qendren e qytetit te Tiranes, realizohet nepermjet Unazes Lindore dhe rruges Panorama e Liqenit.
Rrjeti rrugor eshte i brendshem duke lehtesuar aksesin ne cdo banese . Per krijimin e nje parku rekreativ eshte menduar pjesa qe ndodhet ne qender te zones duke bere te mundur qasjen e barabarte persa i perket
distancave nga te gjithe banoret.
Tipologjite e ndertimit: B
VILA B
180 m2 te ndara ne 2 kate x 90 m2 dhe Oborr 150 m2 dhe vende parkimi.
Cmimi i afishuar vlen per pagesen me keste. Per pagese te plote ka hapsire per diskutim.
Info;Mundesia eshte ne ndarje ne dy apartamente x90m2 me shkalle te jashtme.
VILAT do kene edhe tarracen e Shfrytezueshme duke krijuar nje shkalle te brendshme.
Pishinat jane opsionale te paperfshira ne cmim por mund te porositen nga klienti.
Kthimi I Investimit eshte ne me pak se 10 vite nese sdo kete asnje rritje te vleres se prones dhe nese do kete nje trend akoma te rritjes do mund te jete edhe ne 7 vite me nje ARR (Anualised Rate of Return) 10-13%
Prona gjithashtu ka vlere te shtuar ne kolateral per cdo likujditet per investime te tjera te ardhshme.
Duke filluar nga janar 2026 pritet qe zona liqenit te Farkes te kete reference shteterore 2700 Euro / m2 duke vleresuar vilat B ne rreth 500.000 Euro vlere tregu kolateral.
Projekti pritet qe te mbaroje ne me pak se 30 muaj ne te gjithe komponentet e vet.
title_en: Villa for sale at Farke lake
description_en: Smart Hills is one of the newest projects in the area, which is positioned in the west of the Farka lake. This area is known for its residential values, which are expressed in terms of climate and environment. It is worth mentioning the panoramic view offered in the South-West direction. The area is rich in water resources in the form of lakes, water basins and streams. The vegetation in this area is rich in types of bushes and medium trees. It is worth mentioning the Farka Lake, which is an attraction located about 200 m from the location of the property. In terms of commercial services, the property has a distance of 3.7 km from the TEG shopping center. The main connection with the center of the city of Tirana is realized through the Eastern ring road and Panorama e Liqeni street. The road network is internal, facilitating access to every apartment. For the creation of a recreational park, the part located in the center of the area is considered, making possible equal access in terms of distances from all residents. Construction typologies: B VILLA B 180 m2 divided into 2 floors x 90 m2 and Yard 150 m2 and parking spaces. The posted price is valid for cash payment. For full payment there is room for discussion. Info: The opportunity is divided into two x90m2 apartments with an external staircase. The VILLA will also have a terrace that can be used, creating an internal staircase. Pools are optional, not included in the price, but can be ordered by the customer. The return of the investment is in less than 10 years if there is no increase in the value of the property and if there is still a growth trend, it could be in 7 years with an ARR (Annualized Rate of Return) of 10-13%. The property also has added value in collateral for any liquidity for other future investments. Starting from January 2026, it is expected that the Farka lake area will have a state reference of 2,700 Euro / m2, valuing villas B at around 500,000 Euro collateral market value. The project is expected to be completed in less than 30 months in all its components.
